NEET PG 2026 Answer Key to be Released for First Time

The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) will release the NEET PG 2026 answer key for the first time. This decision follows a Supreme Court order directing the medical board to make raw scores, answer keys, and normalisation details publicly available to ensure transparency. The final answer key is expected to be released along with the result by September 30.
